3.6: Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed Available Tender Capacity: (AxNx2.5-B)Where A-Maximum value of works executed (KPTCL & Non-KPTCL) in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2024-2025) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.

3.7: Even though the Tenderers meet the above criteria, they are subject to be disqualified if they have:- Made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or- Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history, or financial failures etc. and/or- Participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high Tender prices and could not furnish rational justification.

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 b) For 66kV/110kV Terminal Bay:The bidder should have satisfactorily Constructed, completed & Commissioned atleast One (1) No. of 66kV or above voltage class Sub-station/Terminal Bay on Total or Partial Trunkey basis in the last ten (10) years preceding the date of bid submission and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One (1) year prior to the date of submission of the Bid.OR The bidder should have satisfactorily constructed, completed and commissioned not less than Five (5) Nos. of 33kV or above voltage class Sub-Stations/Terminal Bays on Total or Partial Turn Key basis in the last ten(10) years preceding the date of Bid Submission and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One (1) year prior to the date of submission of the Bid.OR The Bidder should have carried out erection of atleast One(01) No. of 66kV voltage class or above voltage class Sub-Station Additional Transformer work OR atleast One(01) No. of 66kV voltage class or above voltage class Sub-Station Transformer Replacement/ Augmentation/Capacitor bank installation work on Total or Partial Turnkey Basis in the last 10 years preceding the date of bid submission and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One(1) year prior to the date of submission of the Bid.OR The Bidder should have carried out erection of atleast Two (02) Nos of Agumentation/Replacement/Capacitor bank installation of 66kV or above voltage class Transformer works on Labour Contract Basis in the last 10 years preceding the date of bid submission and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One (01) year prior to the date of submission of the Bid OR Bidder who has executed Additional Transformer works or Replacement of Transformer works of private firms under the direct supervision of ESCOM/KPTCL officers are eligible to participate.
